method.dimensions: One dimension per stage of the Organizational Intelligence Loop. Each is a weighted blend of named measurements over this organization's own records; the factors ship with every score.
method.composite: Weighted mean over measurable dimensions only. A dimension with no input is null and drops out of both numerator and denominator, taking its weight with it.
method.stages: Absent (<0.2) · Emerging (<0.4) · Developing (<0.6) · Established (<0.8) · Compounding (>=0.8). Names describe the loop, not a vendor maturity model.

method.trend: Ordinary least squares over every complete calendar period. Direction is reported only when the slope clears its own standard error, |t| >= 2; otherwise flat. Series are fitted on measurements with physically impossible values excluded.
method.partial: A final period holding fewer records than half the median period is treated as still filling and excluded from the fit.
method.concentration: A single classifier value accounting for at least 40% of a dataset.

firstAction.recommendation: Derive evidence confidence at ingestion instead of defaulting it
firstAction.why: Confidence is an input to every reasoning step downstream. A constant carries no information, so it cannot separate strong evidence from weak, and every confidence-weighted figure in the system is effectively unweighted.
firstAction.nextAction: Evidence confidence varies with source reliability and freshness at the point of ingestion.
